examples.hanzi: 外面阴了，带把伞吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn yīn le, dài bǎ sǎn ba.
examples.english: It has turned cloudy outside, so take an umbrella.

examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān wǒmen zuò zài shùyīn xià chéngliáng.
examples.english: In summer we sit in the shade of the trees to cool off.

examples.hanzi: 我们打算筹办一场晚会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn chóubàn yì chǎng wǎnhuì.
examples.english: We plan to organize an evening party.

examples.pinyin: Tā wèi péngyou de shǒushù chóu le hěn duō qián.
examples.english: He raised a lot of money for his friend's surgery.

examples.hanzi: 她是学校摄影社的社长。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì xuéxiào shèyǐngshè de shèzhǎng.
examples.english: She is the president of the school photography club.

examples.pinyin: Xīnwénshè de jìzhě zhèngzài cǎifǎng tā.
examples.english: A reporter from the news agency is interviewing him.

examples.hanzi: 这种蜂蜜非常甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng fēngmì fēicháng tián.
examples.english: This kind of honey is very sweet.

examples.hanzi: 他们是一对甜蜜的小夫妻。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen shì yí duì tiánmì de xiǎo fūqī.
examples.english: They are a sweet young couple.

examples.hanzi: 今天风大，你穿得太薄了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān fēng dà, nǐ chuān de tài báo le.
examples.english: It is windy today, and you are dressed too thinly.

examples.hanzi: 他把面团擀得很薄。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ miàntuán gǎn de hěn báo.
examples.english: He cut the dough very thin.

examples.hanzi: 我的手机铃声太小了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī língshēng tài xiǎo le.
examples.english: My phone's ringtone is too quiet.

examples.hanzi: 有人在门外按门铃。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén zài mén wài àn ménlíng.
examples.english: Someone is ringing the doorbell outside.

examples.hanzi: 商品价格已经含税了。
examples.pinyin: Shāngpǐn jiàgé yǐjīng hán shuì le.
examples.english: The price of the goods already includes tax.

examples.hanzi: 公司每年都要交税。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī měinián dōu yào jiāoshuì.
examples.english: The company has to pay taxes every year.

examples.hanzi: 这趟旅行的行程很满。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tàng lǚxíng de xíngchéng hěn mǎn.
examples.english: The itinerary for this trip is packed.

examples.hanzi: 他是一名软件工程师。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yì míng ruǎnjiàn gōngchéngshī.
examples.english: He is a software engineer.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈在厨房里捏饺子。
examples.pinyin: Māma zài chúfáng lǐ niē jiǎozi.
examples.english: Mom is shaping dumplings in the kitchen.

examples.hanzi: 他捏着鼻子走过了垃圾桶。
examples.pinyin: Tā niē zhe bízi zǒu guò le lājītǒng.
examples.english: He held his nose as he walked past the trash can.

examples.hanzi: 你好，请问卫生间怎么走？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn wèishēngjiān zěnme zǒu?
examples.english: Hello, how do I get to the restroom?

examples.hanzi: 饭前要先洗手，注意卫生。
examples.pinyin: Fàn qián yào xiān xǐshǒu, zhùyì wèishēng.
examples.english: Wash your hands before meals and pay attention to hygiene.

examples.hanzi: 这些旧报纸都是废纸。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù bàozhǐ dōu shì fèizhǐ.
examples.english: These old newspapers are all waste paper.

examples.hanzi: 这个计划被取消了，等于废了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà bèi qǔxiāo le, děngyú fèi le.
examples.english: This plan was cancelled, so it is as good as scrapped.

examples.hanzi: 我坐了很久，腿有点发麻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuò le hěn jiǔ, tuǐ yǒudiǎn fāmá.
examples.english: I have been sitting too long and my foot has gone numb.

examples.hanzi: 这家店的麻婆豆腐很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de mápó dòufu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: The mapo tofu at this restaurant is delicious.

examples.hanzi: 他欠了钱，还想赖账。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiàn le qián, hái xiǎng làizhàng.
examples.english: He owes money and still wants to deny the debt.

examples.hanzi: 小狗总是赖在我身边不走。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu zǒngshì lài zài wǒ shēnbiān bù zǒu.
examples.english: The puppy always clings to my side and will not leave.

examples.hanzi: 经理每天都要监督工作进度。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ měitiān dōu yào jiāndū gōngzuò jìndù.
examples.english: The manager has to monitor the work progress every day.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈总是督促我多读书。
examples.pinyin: Māma zǒngshì dūcù wǒ duō dúshū.
examples.english: Mom is always urging me to read more.

examples.hanzi: 医生建议孩子多吃乳制品。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì háizi duō chī rǔzhìpǐn.
examples.english: The doctor suggests that kids eat more dairy products.

examples.hanzi: 早上我喜欢喝一杯牛乳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang wǒ xǐhuan hē yì bēi niúrǔ.
examples.english: I like having a glass of milk in the morning.

examples.hanzi: 想去就去呗，别犹豫了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng qù jiù qù bei, bié yóuyù le.
examples.english: If you want to go, just go. Don't hesitate.

examples.hanzi: 喜欢就买呗，价格不贵。
examples.pinyin: Xǐhuan jiù mǎi bei, jiàgé bú guì.
examples.english: If you like it, just buy it. It is not expensive.

examples.hanzi: 蚊子咬了我，我的腿很痒。
examples.pinyin: Wénzi yǎo le wǒ, wǒ de tuǐ hěn yǎng.
examples.english: A mosquito bit me and my leg is very itchy.

examples.hanzi: 别挠我，我怕痒痒！
examples.pinyin: Bié náo wǒ, wǒ pà yǎngyang!
examples.english: Don't tickle me. I am ticklish!

examples.hanzi: 他一只手持着雨伞，一只手拿着包。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì zhī shǒu chí zhe yǔsǎn, yì zhī shǒu ná zhe bāo.
examples.english: He holds an umbrella in one hand and carries a bag in the other.

examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ yìzhí zhīchí wǒ.
examples.english: Thank you for always supporting me.

examples.hanzi: 她微微一笑，没有说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā wēiwēi yí xiào, méiyǒu shuōhuà.
examples.english: She smiled slightly and said nothing.

examples.hanzi: 我给朋友发了一条微信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi péngyou fā le yì tiáo wēixìn.
examples.english: I sent my friend a WeChat message.

examples.hanzi: 这杯茶泡得太浓了，我不习惯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bēi chá pào de tài nóng le, wǒ bù xíguàn.
examples.english: This tea is brewed too strong.

examples.hanzi: 院子里有浓浓的花香。
examples.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ yǒu nóngnóng de huāxiāng.
examples.english: The yard is filled with a rich floral scent.

examples.hanzi: 看到孩子撒谎，他非常愤怒。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào háizi sāhuǎng, tā fēicháng fènnù.
examples.english: Seeing the child lie, he was very angry.

examples.hanzi: 你别发怒，我们慢慢谈。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié fānù, wǒmen mànmàn tán.
examples.english: Don't lose your temper. Let's talk calmly.

examples.hanzi: 这棵树的树干特别巨大。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē shù de shùgàn tèbié jùdà.
examples.english: The trunk of this tree is extremely huge.

examples.hanzi: 他为这个项目花了巨款。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zhège xiàngmù huā le jùkuǎn.
examples.english: He spent a huge sum on this project.

examples.hanzi: 广场上挂着很多彩旗。
examples.pinyin: Guǎngchǎng shàng guà zhe hěn duō cǎiqí.
examples.english: Many colorful flags hang in the square.

examples.hanzi: 升旗仪式在早上八点开始。
examples.pinyin: Shēngqí yíshì zài zǎoshang bā diǎn kāishǐ.
examples.english: The flag-raising ceremony begins at eight in the morning.

examples.hanzi: 多喝水对肾有好处。
examples.pinyin: Duō hē shuǐ duì shèn yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: Drinking more water is good for your kidneys.

examples.hanzi: 医生说他的肾功能正常。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā de shèn gōngnéng zhèngcháng.
examples.english: The doctor says his kidney function is normal.

examples.english: The little rabbit is hopping around on the grass.

examples.pinyin: Tā gāoxìng de bèng le qǐlái.
examples.english: He was so happy that he jumped up.

examples.hanzi: 我吃了太多，肚子有点疼。

examples.english: I ate too much and my stomach hurts a bit.

examples.hanzi: 他喝了一肚子水。
examples.pinyin: Tā hē le yí dùzi shuǐ.
examples.english: He drank a bellyful of water.

examples.hanzi: 这条河的水源很干净。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de shuǐyuán hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: The water source of this river is very clean.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhǎo wèntí de gēnyuán.
examples.english: He is looking for the root of the problem.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān wǎnshang dōu yào xǐyù.
examples.english: I take a bath every evening.

examples.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn de yùshì hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: The hotel bathroom is very clean.

examples.pinyin: Chūntiān dào le, cǎodì shàng shēngjī bóbó.
examples.english: Spring has come, and the meadow is full of life.

examples.pinyin: Tā tīng le zhè huà, bórán dà nù.
examples.english: Hearing this, he flew into a rage.

examples.pinyin: Nǎinai jīnnián bāshí suì dàshòu.
examples.english: Grandma celebrates her eightieth birthday this year.

examples.english: We bought longevity noodles for Grandpa.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuāng xī guì dì, xiàng tā qiúhūn.
examples.english: He knelt on both knees and proposed to her.

examples.english: I want to pan-fry a fish for dinner.

examples.english: This crepe is fragrant and crispy.

examples.english: This room is so dirty it is unpleasant to look at.

examples.pinyin: Tā de chǔjìng shífēn lángbèi bùkān.
examples.english: His situation is utterly wretched.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù hǒnghong háizi, tā zài kū.

examples.english: He bought flowers to cheer up his girlfriend.

examples.english: The hunter went up the mountain with his dog.

examples.english: This fox is hunting rabbits.

examples.pinyin: Hánfēng chuī guò, shùyè sèsè zuòxiǎng.
examples.english: As the cold wind blows past, the leaves rustle.

examples.pinyin: Tā hàipà de sèsè fādǒu.
examples.english: He trembled with fear.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuànyì gānkǔ yǔ gòng.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù gānxīn jiù zhèyàng fàngqì.
examples.english: She is not willing to give up just like that.

examples.pinyin: Tā gěi háizi bāo le yí ge jīdàn.
examples.english: She peeled an egg for the child.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì bu huì bāo xiākér?
examples.english: Do you know how to shell shrimp?

examples.hanzi: 婚礼的司仪讲得很风趣。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ de sīyí jiǎng de hěn fēngqù.
examples.english: The wedding host spoke in a very humorous way.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yòng yíqì jiǎnchá tā de xīnzàng.
examples.english: The doctor checked his heart with an instrument.

examples.hanzi: 那只小猴子特别调皮。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī xiǎo hóuzi tèbié tiáopí.
examples.english: That little monkey is especially naughty.

examples.hanzi: 我弟弟是属猴的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi shì shǔ hóu de.
examples.english: He was born in the Year of the Monkey.

examples.hanzi: 这种茶叶是用花熏出来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cháyè shì yòng huā xūn chūlái de.
examples.english: This tea is scented with flowers.

examples.hanzi: 厨房里的烟把我熏得直流泪。
examples.pinyin: Chúfáng lǐ de yān bǎ wǒ xūn de zhí liúlèi.
examples.english: The smoke in the kitchen made my eyes water.

examples.pinyin: Xuéshengmen dōu hěn zūnjìng lǎoshī.
examples.english: The students all respect their teacher.

examples.hanzi: 请问您尊姓大名？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nín zūnxìng dàmíng?
examples.english: May I ask your honorable name?

examples.hanzi: 今天人多，我们凑在一起吃饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān rén duō, wǒmen còu zài yìqǐ chīfàn ba.
examples.english: There are many people today, so let's eat together.

examples.pinyin: Tā còu dào wǒ ěrbiān xiǎoshēng shuō le jǐ jù huà.
examples.english: He leaned close to my ear and whispered a few words.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在沙滩上堆了一个沙堡。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài shātān shàng duī le yí ge shābǎo.
examples.english: The kids built a sandcastle on the beach.

examples.hanzi: 午饭我想吃汉堡。
examples.pinyin: Wǔfàn wǒ xiǎng chī hànbǎo.
examples.english: I would like a hamburger for lunch.

examples.hanzi: 这次比赛我们败了，但是不会气馁。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài wǒmen bài le, dànshì bú huì qìněi.
examples.english: We lost this match, but we will not be discouraged.

examples.hanzi: 失败是成功之母。
examples.pinyin: Shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ.
examples.english: Failure is the mother of success.

examples.hanzi: 她白天上班，晚上兼职做家教。
examples.pinyin: Tā báitiān shàngbān, wǎnshang jiānzhí zuò jiājiào.
examples.english: She works in the daytime and tutors part-time in the evening.

examples.hanzi: 这个房间兼作书房和卧室。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān jiānzuò shūfáng hé wòshì.
examples.english: This room serves as both study and bedroom.

examples.hanzi: 院子里有一棵桃树。
examples.pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ yǒu yì kē táoshù.
examples.english: There is a peach tree in the yard.

examples.hanzi: 春天桃花开得特别美。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān táohuā kāi de tèbié měi.
examples.english: In spring the peach blossoms are especially pretty.

examples.hanzi: 雨停了，天上的乌云慢慢消了。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, tiān shàng de wūyún mànmàn xiāo le.
examples.english: The rain stopped and the dark clouds slowly cleared away.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chī wán fàn yào qù sànbù, bāngzhù xiāohuà.
examples.english: After eating I will take a walk to help digestion.

examples.pinyin: Hóngsè de yīfu xiǎnde tā hěn jīngshen.
examples.english: The red clothes make her look energetic.

examples.hanzi: 他的错误很明显。
examples.pinyin: Tā de cuòwù hěn míngxiǎn.
examples.english: His mistake is obvious.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的装修很朴素。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhuāngxiū hěn pǔsù.
examples.english: This restaurant's decor is very plain.

examples.hanzi: 他是一个朴实的农民。

examples.english: He is a simple and honest farmer.
